source: ChatGPT web image generation in EyeToy Game Assets via Kimi WebBridge
prompt: Generate a landscape 2:1 asset sheet for playpop.party, Floor Is Lava. Two equal square panels meeting exactly halfway, no border or divider. LEFT half is a full-bleed seamless-style top-down field of flowing vermilion and orange molten lava, broken dark red rafts, winding yellow crayon fissures. RIGHT half is one bold die-cut sticker of a tiny tropical green grassy stone island with a sunny yellow home flag on a wooden pole; front three-quarter view, flat mossy top and chunky purple stone sides, centered with 10 percent padding, on an entirely plain pure white background for easy cutout. Match the existing childlike wax-crayon art: uneven charcoal outlines, wax grain, bold imperfect fills. No words, letters, numbers, people, UI, checkerboard or frame. Generate the actual image.

assets.use: Left panel. The game blends the tile edges, bends the streaks into a current and adds rising bubbles across the viewport. HOME is cut out in camera coordinates.
Right panel. Outer white background removed. Catalog sticker and HOME flag.

animation: At zero, the round clock drives the lava flow and bubble bursts. Pausing freezes the surface. Reduced motion shows a still frame. The movement demonstration composites both sprites with two figures walking to the zone.
